description: A guild's registered probing intent for the load-calendar exercise. Must match PROBING-INTENT-CONVENTION.md exactly. Hard rules (write/flood/mint require scratch_only=true and a scratch: target; burst requires a scratch: target; end > start; no duplicate intent_id) are enforced by register-intent.mjs.

contact.description: Room handle or worker identity of the prober.

expected_total.description: Request cap for the window. Integer >= 1.

intent_id.description: Unique id for this intent. uuid v4.

kind.description: Probe kind. write/flood/mint/claim-update REQUIRE scratch_only=true and a scratch: target.

ramp.description: burst is only legal on scratch: targets.

rate_rps.description: Sustained requests per second. Must be > 0.

registered_at.description: Added by register-intent.mjs at registration time; optional on input.

scratch_only.description: REQUIRED true for kind in {write, flood, mint, claim-update}.

target.description: Exact room or route: "muse-room" | "scratch:<room-id>" | "api:<route-path>". Never just "production".

window_end.description: Window end (ISO 8601). Must be after window_start.

title: ProbingIntent
